_about: Public-domain Ludwig von Pastor (1854-1928, Innsbruck historian, Austrian envoy to the Holy See) in English for the Word Hoard: The History of the Popes from the Close of the Middle Ages, vols 1-18 (1891-1929), edited from the German by Frederick Ignatius Antrobus (vols 1-6) and Ralph Francis Kerr (vols 7-18), from Internet Archive scans. Vols 19 onward were printed from 1930 and are left out. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
